metadata.description: Community components, layouts, instruments and spaces for the Dimension platform. Slots are open and layout-owned; well-known names are published conventions (doc 68 §4.1).

plugins.name: agents-best-practices
plugins.title: Agents Best Practices
plugins.description: Guidance for building reliable AI agents: how they loop, use tools, plan, remember and stay safe.

plugins.name: artifactory-general-agent
plugins.title: General Agents
plugins.description: See every agent you can run as a card with its face and its week at a glance, open one to edit it, or ask the Machinist to draft a new one.

plugins.name: artifactory-system-monitor
plugins.title: System Monitor
plugins.description: A live system monitor your agent can read and show beside your chat, as an example app for Dimension.

plugins.name: artifactory-threejs
plugins.title: Three.js
plugins.description: 3D scenes your agent can build and show beside your chat, using the standard Three.js example app.

plugins.name: bluesky
plugins.title: Bluesky
plugins.description: Let your agent research Bluesky: search posts, read threads, profiles, feeds, starter packs, trends and your notifications, and publish posts from your account.

plugins.name: brand-marks
plugins.title: Brand Marks
plugins.description: Ten brand avatars for your agents (X, Reddit, YouTube, Discord, Y Combinator, Product Hunt, Bluesky, Threads, Instagram and TikTok) that move while the agent works.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.title: Browser
plugins.description: A real browser beside your chat that your agent drives while you watch. Tabs, persistent logged-in profiles, circle-to-annotate, and an optional fast task agent (jev).

plugins.name: build
plugins.title: Build
plugins.description: A workspace for coding put together entirely from plugins. Install it beside Code and swap any part without touching the app.

showcase.tagline: Every part of this workspace is a pack you can swap.

plugins.name: chat
plugins.title: Chat
plugins.description: A calm space for talking to Aether, with no code or branches in sight, your past sessions listed and a viewer for the documents, slides and images it makes.

showcase.tagline: Your assistant in a room of its own, with a face you can talk to.
showcase.summary: A calm conversation with Aether, your past sessions beside it, and whatever it makes opening next to it. Open Face to face to talk it through out loud, or start a live call that hands anything about your work to your agent.
showcase.onboarding: Send a first message, then open Face to face to talk.

plugins.name: chat-rail
plugins.title: Chat Rail
plugins.description: The session list for the Chat space: only your conversations, newest first, with search, a New session button and collections you make yourself.

plugins.name: chat-thread
plugins.title: Chat Thread
plugins.description: The conversation view for the Chat space: your words and the assistant's, one quiet "Worked for" line per turn and a card for any file or interface it shows you.

plugins.name: classic-dock
plugins.title: Classic Dock
plugins.description: The standard right-hand panel as an installable part: its tab strip, resize handle and panel body.

plugins.name: classic-environment
plugins.title: Classic Environment
plugins.description: The standard project panel as an installable part, with live git status, worktree actions and Push.

plugins.name: classic-rail
plugins.title: Classic Rail
plugins.description: The standard session list as an installable part: projects, search and every row.

plugins.name: classic-start
plugins.title: Classic Start
plugins.description: The standard start screen as an installable part: the big message box and the project and where-to-work menus.

plugins.name: classic-switcher
plugins.title: Classic Switcher
plugins.description: The standard space switcher column as an installable part.

plugins.name: classic-workspace
plugins.title: Classic Workspace Host
plugins.description: The standard centre pane as an installable part: its splits, tiling and overlays.

plugins.name: clients
plugins.title: Clients
plugins.description: Win and keep enterprise customers for any product: offerings, campaigns, prospects, warm paths, the pipeline, meetings and customers in one local database. Agents draft; nothing is sent or promised without your click.

showcase.tagline: A sales team of agents that waits for your click.
showcase.summary: Clients is a space for winning and keeping enterprise customers. Head of Sales, the Researcher, the Solutions Engineer and the Account Manager find companies that fit an offering, record the dated reason to reach each one now, and draft every email and promise. Each one waits on Today until you approve it. Prospects, Pipeline, Results, Meetings and Customers read from one local database, and every fact links to its source.

plugins.name: discord
plugins.title: Discord
plugins.description: Let your agent read, answer and run your own Discord server through a bot you create: messages, forum posts, search, invites, events and announcements.

plugins.name: dopamine-debt
plugins.title: Dopamine Debt
plugins.description: Makes deadpan, meme-led comedy explainer films about your channel's subject, and checks every stage against house rules before you spend on voice and music.

generalAgents.name: filmmaker
generalAgents.description: Makes deadpan, meme-led comedy explainer films for your channel, from audience research to an approved render, with the Dopamine Debt framework and its film kit

plugins.name: example-agents
plugins.title: Example Agents
plugins.description: An example of how to share an agent: one space with a sample marketing lead that starts switched off.

showcase.tagline: A reference space for contributors: the Build workspace, scoped to one General Agent — the Example Hub's marketing lead.

generalAgents.name: example-cmo
generalAgents.description: A sample marketing lead for the Example Hub — ships off by default; enable it in Capabilities → General Agents

plugins.name: face-to-face
plugins.title: Face to face
plugins.description: Talk to your agent and watch it answer: a full-screen face that lip-syncs to the real audio and captions every word as it is spoken. Where available, Talk live adds a real-time voice.

plugins.name: gen-fal
plugins.title: fal.ai generators
plugins.description: Turn pictures into 3D models with the generators on fal.ai, using one key. You see the price before every job.

plugins.name: gen-local-3d
plugins.title: Local image-to-3D
plugins.description: Turn pictures into 3D models on your own graphics card. No account, no key and no per-model cost.

plugins.name: gen-tripo
plugins.title: Tripo 3D generation
plugins.description: Make 3D models from one or more pictures with Tripo, then split, rig, animate and convert them. You pay Tripo per use with your own key.

plugins.name: gen-wavespeed
plugins.title: WaveSpeed generators
plugins.description: Turn pictures into 3D models with the generators on WaveSpeed AI, using one key. You see the price before every job.

plugins.name: generative-ui
plugins.title: Generative UI
plugins.description: Generative UI: the assistant shows you a designed interface (a trip plan, a comparison, a checklist, a schedule, a summary with numbers) instead of a wall of text. A closed palette of blocks, drawn in your theme, with buttons that answer back.

plugins.name: github
plugins.title: GitHub
plugins.description: Let your agent work with GitHub issues, pull requests, releases and repositories, using the gh tool on your computer.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.title: Gmail
plugins.description: Let your agent read and search your email, and send messages from your mailbox.

plugins.name: google-calendar
plugins.title: Google Calendar
plugins.description: Let your agent manage your Google Calendar events and schedule.

plugins.name: google-drive
plugins.title: Google Drive
plugins.description: Let your agent list, search and read the files in your Google Drive.

plugins.name: google-meet
plugins.title: Google Meet
plugins.description: Create Google Meet meetings, read their recordings and transcripts, and transcribe a call as it happens.

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.title: Google Workspace
plugins.description: Let your agent read and edit your Google Sheets, Docs and Slides.

plugins.name: hackernews
plugins.title: Hacker News
plugins.description: Let your agent read Hacker News: search stories and comments, read a thread, check an account and a site's history, and watch a launch. Read only, no account needed.

plugins.name: image
plugins.title: Image
plugins.description: Make and edit images, and cut out transparent backgrounds on your computer. Pick any model for a single picture.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.title: Impeccable
plugins.description: Design guidance for your agent: commands to craft, polish, critique and audit a design, plus rules that keep it from producing generic-looking work.

plugins.name: independent-composer
plugins.title: Independent Composer
plugins.description: An example message box built only from the public UI parts, to show how to build your own.

plugins.name: independent-rail
plugins.title: Independent Rail
plugins.description: An example session list built only from the public UI parts, to show how to build your own.

plugins.name: independent-thread
plugins.title: Independent Thread
plugins.description: An example conversation view built only from the public UI parts, to show how to build your own.

plugins.name: last30days
plugins.title: last30days
plugins.description: Research what people actually said about any topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News and the web.

plugins.name: mochi-mark
plugins.title: Mochi Mark
plugins.description: A tiny example icon that shows how a plugin draws in the space switcher.

plugins.name: newsletter
plugins.title: Newsletter
plugins.description: Let your agent save the newsletter issues you choose as unsent drafts in your beehiiv, Kit, Buttondown or Ghost account, and read how each issue did. You always press Send yourself.

plugins.name: pr-viewer
plugins.title: PR Viewer
plugins.description: See a pull request's review in the right-hand panel; with it installed, review chips open here instead of in your browser.

plugins.name: product-psychology
plugins.title: Product Psychology
plugins.description: Find where people get lost or drop off in your product, research your users, and check persuasion for ethics.

plugins.name: pulse-mark
plugins.title: Pulse Mark
plugins.description: An example icon that lights up when any session is busy, to show how a plugin can read live session data.

plugins.name: reddit
plugins.title: Reddit
plugins.description: Let your agent read Reddit: a subreddit's posts and rules, a thread's comments, search and your public profile. Read-only.

plugins.name: rooms-rail
plugins.title: Rooms Rail
plugins.description: The session list for rooms spaces: the space's own header, direct messages, channels and projects, an Organise menu and a marker on rows that need you.

plugins.name: router-jev
plugins.title: Jev room router
plugins.description: Uses the Jev model to decide, when you post in a room without naming anyone, which agent answers first and who else joins in.

plugins.name: simulator
plugins.title: Simulator
plugins.description: An Android phone emulator beside your chat that your agent can drive while you watch: tap, type, install and open apps.

plugins.name: slack
plugins.title: Slack
plugins.description: Let your agent use Slack two ways: as a bot app you add to channels, or as you through your own account. Connect one or both.

plugins.name: social-listening
plugins.title: Social Listening
plugins.description: Hear what communities really say about a topic, find the conversations worth joining and the creators worth contacting, and collect your audience's own words.

plugins.name: speech-elevenlabs
plugins.title: ElevenLabs voice
plugins.description: Dictate, hear replies and talk live in ElevenLabs voices. Paste your own ElevenLabs API key to connect; until then it is idle and sends nothing.

plugins.name: swiss-knife
plugins.title: Swiss Knife
plugins.description: A few small helpers in one switch: your agent can show you files as cards you can open and mark up, a library finds every file you have made, and it stops the agent adding code comments.

plugins.name: taste
plugins.title: Taste
plugins.description: Helps your agent design interfaces that look considered: it reads your brief first, uses real design systems and avoids generic AI looks.

plugins.name: teams
plugins.title: Microsoft Teams
plugins.description: Let your agent list your Microsoft Teams teams and channels and post messages to a channel.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.title: Telegram
plugins.description: Let your agent send Telegram messages, read new ones and look at chats, using a bot you create.

plugins.name: triage-rail
plugins.title: Triage Rail
plugins.description: A session list built around what needs you: a Needs-you strip with the oldest wait first, then Now, Today, Yesterday and earlier groups, plus one Sweep to archive idle sessions older than a week.

plugins.name: ui-skills
plugins.title: UI Skills
plugins.description: Skills that polish interfaces: solid basics, accessibility fixes, page-metadata checks and smoother animation.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.title: Watch
plugins.description: Let your agent watch a video from a link or a file: it samples frames and reads a transcript with timestamps.

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.title: WhatsApp
plugins.description: Let your agent send WhatsApp text messages and message templates through your WhatsApp Business account.

plugins.name: x
plugins.title: X
plugins.description: Let your agent read your X (Twitter) mentions and timelines, search, and post.

plugins.name: youtube
plugins.title: YouTube
plugins.description: Let your agent search YouTube, look at videos and channels, manage playlists, read or post comments, read analytics and reach for every channel you connect, upload a video, change a posted video's title or thumbnail, and get a finished film ready to upload.
